title: [SEP-10] Private-Space icon and custom-emoji images may be pinned in plaintext under a chain
description: Review finding SEP-10: Private-Space icon and custom-emoji images may be pinned in plaintext under a chain (lens SEP). Location: spec/05-messaging.md:529, 549; spec/03-spaces.md:57, 188; spec/14-jmap.md:117. Fix: As proposed. §3.4's mirroring rule (03:188) covers only "Records that name members", and the §14.3.4 blob-encryption rule (14:117) covers blobs referenced by JMAP durable objects, not Space-state `iconCID` or `customEmoji`. A pin instruction carries an access proof for a registered chain, so a plaintext logo links chain to Space (S1). For non-public Spaces, encrypt icon and emoji blobs under a content key carried in Space state, and widen 03:188 to "Space-identifying content". Full text: notes/review/SEP-verified.md and notes/review/SEP.md.
